lessons.name: THE ORDER STRUCTURE AT MODULUS 91. The 72 residues coprime to 91 are all killed by the exponent 12 — a^12 = 1 for every unit a — and no proper divisor of 12 kills them all (all 5 of them checked). So 12 is the exponent of (Z/91)*, the Carmichael lambda, computed here rather than looked up. This is the number every obstruction at this modulus actually turns on: an exponent n reaches the group only through gcd(n, 12), which is why the survey below is indexed by that and not by n.

lessons.name: THE ORDER STRUCTURE AT MODULUS 112.
